note: Question stem templates per Bloom's level. Placeholders in {curly_braces} are filled by the user or expanded by the AI engine. Templates are topic-agnostic so they work for any nursing subject.

stem_templates: Which {structure|term|definition} is described as {description}?
Which of the following best defines {concept}?
Which {tool|structure|term} is used for {purpose}?
Which of the following is a normal finding for {structure}?
Which {term} refers to {definition}?
Which structure is responsible for {function}?
Which of the following is the correct {term} for {description}?
Remembering.rationale_pattern: State the correct answer and its definition/function. Briefly explain why each distractor is incorrect by naming what it actually does.

stem_templates: A patient reports {symptom}. Which {structure|process} is most likely involved?
Which finding indicates {normal|abnormal} {function}?
A client asks about {topic}. Which statement best explains {concept}?
Which of the following describes the function of {structure} during {process}?
Which statement best explains why {phenomenon} occurs?
Understanding.rationale_pattern: Explain the underlying principle or mechanism. Correct the misconception in each distractor.

stem_templates: Which tool is used to assess {structure|function}?
Which technique best demonstrates {procedure}?
Which finding is expected when assessing {structure} in a {age_group} client?
Which action should the nurse take to perform {procedure} correctly?
Which of the following is the correct step when assessing {system}?
Applying.rationale_pattern: State the correct technique/tool and why it is appropriate. Explain what each distractor actually assesses or represents.

stem_templates: A {age}-year-old client presents with {chief_complaint}. On assessment, {finding}. What is the best interpretation?
A client reports {symptom}. Assessment reveals {data}. Which condition is most likely?
During {procedure}, the nurse notes {finding}. What is the best nursing interpretation?
A {age}-year-old client has {finding}. Which factor best explains this result?
The nurse assesses {finding} in a client with {condition}. What is the best analysis of this finding?
Analyzing.rationale_pattern: Interpret the finding using the underlying pathophysiology or principle. Explain why each distractor is a plausible but incorrect interpretation.

stem_templates: A client presents with {data}. What is the best nursing action?
A {age}-year-old client reports {complaint} and shows {finding}. What is the best next step?
The nurse assesses {finding} in a client with {condition}. What is the priority nursing action?
A client's assessment reveals {data}. Which nursing action is most appropriate?
Which nursing action should be performed FIRST for a client presenting with {findings}?
Evaluating.rationale_pattern: Justify the correct action using priority-setting frameworks (ABC, Maslow, safety). Explain why distractors are either unsafe, inappropriate, or lower priority.

stem_templates: A {age}-year-old client is being discharged with {condition}. Which {care plan|teaching plan|discharge plan} is most appropriate?
Design a {nursing intervention|teaching strategy} for a client with {condition}. Which sequence is correct?
Formulate a prioritized plan of care for a client presenting with {findings}. Which action should the nurse include FIRST?
Which discharge teaching plan best addresses the needs of a client with {condition} and {barrier}?
The nurse is creating a {care plan|community program} for {population}. Which component should be prioritized?
Creating.rationale_pattern: Justify the constructed plan against principles of patient-centered care, teaching-learning, and safety. Explain why distractors are incomplete, misprioritized, or inappropriate for the client's context.
